title: Voyage Loop Orchestrator
description: Main loop tying batch generation and tournament together. Run batch (N techniques) against reference, evaluate fitness, tournament selection, record winners/lineage/fitness, repeat for M rounds. CLI: uv run voyage --reference skull.obj --rounds 5 --techniques primitives,curve_sweep,radius_closure,bi_rail_loft. Persists state to ~/.ix/voyage/runs/<run-id>/. This is the MVP -- rounds with parallel technique exploration, ranked by Chamfer + VLM. Depends on VOYAGE-2 and VOYAGE-4.
definition-of-done: 1. voyage CLI entry point in pyproject.toml. 2. Runs M rounds of batch generation + tournament. 3. Records winners, lineage, fitness history per round. 4. Persists full run state to ~/.ix/voyage/runs/<run-id>/. 5. Fitness of best-per-round generally improves across rounds.
testing-plan: 1. Run 3 rounds with 4 techniques each = 12 total attempts. 2. Verify run state persisted correctly. 3. Verify fitness history shows best-per-round. 4. Verify resume from interrupted run.
todos: Add --resume flag for continuing interrupted runs
